platformDependencySuccessor.name: EmploymentContractTemplateSnapshotV1
rules: templatePublicId and templateVersion identify exactly one immutable published version
effective interval is half-open and contains the request effectiveFrom
locale is an exact canonical match; no silent locale fallback
scopeType and scopeId must match the trusted relationship/legal-employer scope
payloadDigest equals the Platform PDX-001 configuration payload digest
template public ID/version/state/effectivity/digest exactly match the PDX-001 published reference
document bytes and unrestricted URLs are forbidden

peopleTemplatePort.ownerRule: IAQ-008 and PEP-HRM-011 trust only this port result for template publication, effectivity, locale, scope, contractType, content reference and approval receipt.
peopleTemplatePort.failureRule: Unavailable, stale, mismatched or ambiguous template authority produces UNAVAILABLE for the query component and a fail-closed command rejection before artifact invocation or mutation.

artifactBoundaryCorrection.artifactPortRole: Render/seal the already authorized immutable template and generation snapshot; never determine publication, effectivity, scope, locale or contract type.
